counts.clip_variant_choice: count existing numbered clips, roll one

rule: One base creature record; a variant names its base in CNAM and carries its own stats; scale multiplies the reference scale; sound lookup falls back from the variant's base id to any creature sharing the same model, then to a generic set. A levelled list picks one record by player level: chance-none roll first, then only the highest eligible level tier (or every eligible tier when the list's all-levels bit is set), then a uniform pick, recursing into nested lists. A rest interruption places a pack of 1 + roll(iNumberCreatures) members, each a levelled pick, 220 units from the player. A creature-list point respawns its creature only after the death stamp plus the lesser of two corpse delays. Natural attacks: three min/max pairs chosen by attack type; damage is linear in swing strength.

data_fields.name: spawn.respawn_grace
data_fields.unit: game time (fCorpseRespawnDelay, fCorpseClearDelay, lesser of the two)

keep: One base record with a variant link, so a re-skin inherits its family.
Sound set looked up by base id, then by shared model, then generic.
Tier pick: chance-none roll, highest eligible tier only (unless flagged), uniform pick.
Bounded pack roll placed at a fixed distance.
Respawn only after the corpse delay has passed.
change: Add a depth cap to the recursive levelled pick (levelledlist.cpp:76-78 has none).
Build the base-id to sound-set map once at load (creature.cpp:614-626 rescans per request).
Re-pick when a list entry is missing so the pack keeps its size (levelledlist.cpp nonexistent-item branch returns none).
Use named fields, not Morrowind flag bits; the creature and item flag bits are swapped in the format (loadlevlist.hpp:68 and :91).
Clamp pack size to MAX_ATTACKERS = 3 and make pack size per-zone data.
Server makes every pick once at spawn and sends the chosen base id; the client presents it.
look_test: Target src/fight/creature-family.ts (proposed), parity row 7. Build one base creature and three variants changing only colour set, scale (0.85, 1.0, 1.2) and one glow accent, all sharing the base voice set. Render a 2-second idle loop and a 375-wide still for each, and a pack of three beside the player. Dom checks: the three read as one family at 375 wide; the scale step is visible in the pack; the glow does not hide the silhouette in the fight camera. Pass if all three read as one family; if not, drop the colour change first.
